title: Mixed Event — Beyond The Dream of That Day — Episode8 For The Ones Who Haven't Seen Yet

meta.Event: Beyond The Dream of That Day
meta.Episode: Episode8 — For The Ones Who Haven't Seen Yet
meta.Event Outline: After putting on a successful solo show, MORE MORE JUMP! starts thinking about their next goal. During that time, they're offered a chance to appear on TV. Everyone is excited to hear the news, except Haruka, who doesn't quite share in their optimism...

rows.Line: The next day
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Rooftop

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Alright...
Now that we've had a night to sleep on it...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Let's return to discussing how we all feel about appearing on TV.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
O-Okay.
So... Who should start?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Mind if I?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Sure...
You have the floor.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Then, I'll get straight to the point...
I...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I'm in favor of us appearing on TV.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: What...?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I honestly wasn't expecting you to say that, Haruka... What made you change your mind?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: So, the thing is...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
That's so wonderful...!
Your hero was really in the newspaper...?!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
She was.
I had no idea what had happened to her after she retired from being an idol.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But that article showed me that she's still spreading hope to many people, even though she's not an idol anymore...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: And I found that incredibly encouraging...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Haruka...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Which made me think...
Yes, I am afraid that the media can take things out of context and skew our image...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: However, that also means it has the power to allow us to spread hope to more and more people, including those we have yet to encounter.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: This article showed me just that...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
You're right...
I was actually gonna say something similar today.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: For example, they may not realize it yet, but there may be people out there who really need some hope...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Those who need hope but don't realize it...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah. I mean, the ones who really have it rough only have time to worry about themselves. They wouldn't be running around seeing their favorite idols perform, right?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But I think TV has the power to bring us together.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Newspapers are no different.
Haruka, you just happened to come across an article about your hero and felt encouraged, right?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Imagine if we're able to give someone hope after they just happen to see us on TV? How awesome would that be?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Yeah, that'd be amazing!
And so wonderful...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. Right?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Not only that, our fans are gonna be ecstatic when they see us being exposed to a broader audience on TV.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Which is why I'm for us making this TV appearance...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But I'd like to hear what you all have to say.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: After hearing what you two had to say, Haruka, Airi, I realized that I hadn't given this enough thought, but...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I also want us to make this appearance. Until now, we've mainly been doing streams online and...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I'm worried that we're limited to reaching only those who choose to come to watch us...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: It takes me back to how Haruka gave me so much hope when I saw her on TV.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Minori...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Hehe. Alright, Minori's on board...
Last but not least, Shizuku, how do you feel?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I actually wasn't sure what to say until just a moment ago...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: As much as I want us to appear on TV, I found myself sympathizing with what Haruka said yesterday. I'd really rather not see our image get warped by others...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Shizuku...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But after hearing your stories, I'm sure now that we'll be just fine.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Because we're all doing everything we can to spread hope to as many people as possible, yes?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
I believe that won't ever change.
So, even if what we say didn't quite come out the way we wanted it to...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: We can just keep trying over and over. It may take some time, but everyone will eventually understand.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: MEIKO said something similar...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, she did...?!
That makes me so happy.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Hang on, Haruka...
Does that mean you went over to SEKAI?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I was actually quite unsure of myself, so I ended up going over to ask for some advice...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh, Haruka...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: This is a big decision after all...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But I'm glad that I gave it so much thought. I was able to reach the same conclusion as all of you, which means we can start preparing for our TV appearance...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Yeah, wow...
We're really gonna appear on TV...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh no...! I'm starting to get really nervous! Am I gonna be okay?! What if I stammer while on camera?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Slow down. You're getting way too ahead of yourself. We haven't even accepted that person's offer yet.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Oh, about that.
I was thinking about replying to them today.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes, we've all decided that we want to make this appearance, but I kept us from reaching a consensus.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Again, don't worry about that.
This was an important discussion, so it was only right to spend a lot of time on it.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Right...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: However, if you're volunteering to reply, we're not gonna stop you. Also, I'm sure you'll know exactly what to say.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Yeah!
I'm really bad at writing businessy letters and stuff... So, Haruka, if you will!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I can't say that I'm very good at that either... I'd like to ask you to do this for us as well, Haruka.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Okay, no problem.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Our response to this message is likely going to greatly affect the future of MORE MORE JUMP!)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (But we'll be fine. Because...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (We want to become idols who are able to spread hope to not just the people we meet, but also those we yet haven't.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (And this is our first step towards achieving that goal.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Everyone...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Haruka?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Let's keep doing our best. For as long as we can.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku, Airi & Minori
rows.Line:
Yeah!
Yes!
TV Studio

rows.Speaker: New Assistant Director
rows.Line: Oh, sir, hello!

rows.Speaker: Producer
rows.Line: Ah, hello. Nice work today.

rows.Speaker: Producer
rows.Line:
Anyway, that's it for today's shoot.
Tomorrow, we'll be meeting with everyone from U-Symphonium since they'll be the MCs of iHaz next week.

rows.Speaker: Producer
rows.Line: And I'm so glad that MORE MORE JUMP! decided to appear. They're all the rage right now, so it should be a good show...

rows.Speaker: Producer
rows.Line:
Hm?
Who's calling me at this hour?

rows.Speaker: Producer
rows.Line:
Hello...?
Ah, perfect. I was just hoping to speak with the hard-working manager of U-Symphonium... Wait, huh?

rows.Speaker: Producer
rows.Line:
Your lead's in the hospital?!
Th-That's very concerning... Our shoot's just around the corner. Oh, you have a backup group ready?

rows.Speaker: Producer
rows.Line:
Wonderful.
So, which group did you have in mind...?

rows.Speaker: Producer
rows.Line: Cheerful * Days...

rows.Speaker: Producer
rows.Line: No, um...! This program airs late at night, so we'll always welcome having such a popular group on. Thank you very much.

rows.Speaker: Producer
rows.Line: Anyway, we can discuss this further tomorrow during our meeting.
